newsitem.title: CHINA: China's B share indices end up ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: China's B share indices end up ahead of holiday.

text.p: China's B share indices closed up slightly on Thursday on institutional buying, but trading was light ahead of the two-week Chinese new year market holiday which begins next Monday, traders said.
Shanghai's B share index edged up 0.346 points or 0.53 percent to 65.784 points and Shenzhen's B index rose 1.76 points or 1.16 percent to end at 154.46.
The stock exchanges in both Shanghai and Shenzhen will be closed from Monday, February 3 until Monday, February 17.
Institutional buying in counters expected to post good 1996 earnings boosted the indices but the holiday mood dampened follow-up buying, Shenzhen brokers said.
"Major investors have left the market on uncertainties over the holiday," one Shanghai broker said. "Some window-dressing buying from the institutions pushed the index up."
"The indices will consolidate in a narrow range on Friday, the last session before the holiday," a Shenzhen broker said.
In Shanghai, Huili Building Materials was the star on speculative buying, rising $0.014 or 5.26 percent to $0.280 on volume of 104,000 shares.
Retailer Friendship traded the most on inter-institutional activity, up $0.006 or 1.39 percent to $0.436 on volume of 1.8 million shares.
In Shenzhen, Lizhu Pharmaceutical was the best performer and rose HK$0.34 or 6.67 percent to HK$5.44 on volume of 898,313 shares, pushed up by optimism over the firm's outlook, brokers said.
Hainan Pearl River, dragged down by profit-taking, shaved HK$0.06 to HK$3.90 on the day's heaviest volume of 2.94 million shares, brokers said.
On the A share market, Shanghai's A index fell on a correction after gains in the past few days, but trading was dull in the run-up to the holiday, brokers said.
Shanghai's A index fell 2.234 points or 0.22 percent to 1001.937 points.
New Asia Fast Food was the biggest loser on profit-taking after yesterday's jump, slipping 0.41 yuan or 4.93 percent to 7.89 yuan on volume of 317,900 shares.
Meanwhile, Shenzhen's A share index rebounded following Wednesday's falls, ending up 2.35 points or 0.63 percent to 372.35 points, brokers said.

Fertilizer maker Shenzhen Liaohe Tongda Chemical Industry Co Ltd, which listed 117 million A shares on Thursday, ended the session at 11.20 yuan compared with an offer price of 5.38 yuan earlier this month. Volume was 88.94 million shares.
Hainan-based counters were among the day's stars, fuelled by speculation over their 1996 results, brokers said.
Property developer Hainan New Energy soared 0.64 yuan or 8.88 percent to 7.85 yuan as 8.64 million shares changed hands. Hainan Nanyang Shipping surged 0.51 yuan to 6.40 yuan on 14.8 million shares.
